title: Progress
intro: Every session your tutor recorded, and how mastery moved topic by topic. It is the tutor's own record, written after each session.

chart.overTimeBody: One line per topic. Each point is a rating your tutor gave at the end of a session, from 1 to 5.
chart.byTopicBody: The latest rating for every topic taught, with the first rating shown behind it so the movement is visible.
chart.noDataBody: A tutor records topics and a mastery rating after each completed session. Nothing appears here until the first one is written.

topics.heading: Topic by topic
topics.stagnant: No increase in three or more sessions
topics.stagnantBody: Worth raising with the tutor. It may be the right pace for a hard topic, and it may not — but it is the kind of thing that otherwise goes unnoticed for a term.

gaps.heading: The gaps the diagnostic found
gaps.body: What the intake identified at the start, against what has actually been taught since.
gaps.none: No diagnostic was run for this student, so there is nothing to compare against.

sessions.heading: Session notes
sessions.body: The tutor's own words, exactly as written.
sessions.noNote: No written note for this session.

privacy: This page is visible to you and to Ustaad.com administrators. It is not public, and no tutor can see another tutor's notes.
